offenders.note: Runs over the whole masked program. `[^.]*` stops only at a period, so a program with many OPENs and no period between them (or a long unterminated tail) rescans to the end from every OPEN. Fix tracked in #3222.
Runs over one COPY statement's REPLACING clause, so real inputs are short; the unbounded name before a required `BY` is still quadratic in the clause length. Fix tracked in #3222.
Runs over the whole program. `[^.]*\\.` after ASSIGN rescans to the next period from every SELECT: the #3205 shape with a smaller constant. Fix tracked in #3222.
